ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:4 ratio of high-intensity light-grey pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity grey mottling concentrated on inner-to-mid lobe regions; localized low-intensity (dark) circular focal points distributed across the mid-right lobe region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 105 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations across the trailing edge; extreme high-amplitude (10-25 pixel depth) irregular protrusions at both distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the main trailing edge transitioning to a sharp upward-curving distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular high-contrast pixel groups concentrated at the distal tips and along the trailing edge boundary.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pigment disruptions observed on the central-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive physical protrusions and texture irregularities at the lobe tips; distinct circular dark pigment patch or indentation on the lower-middle right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely jagged and thickened appearance of the fluke perimeter due to severe, non-uniform accumulation of high-contrast biological material.
